about_the_game:
Pirate Ghost Ship

This exciting game is designed in the style of action/adventure stealth.

Horror and jump scare genre.

The game mechanics are similar to a combination of Fahrenheit and Inside games to create a high action experience.

The game progress changes based on your decisions and you can even see its feedback in later stages.

Jack, the protagonist, boards a dead pirate ship to search for a cursed treasure map.

After being imprisoned by pirates, he goes in search of the treasure map chest and after obtaining it

and fighting with creatures, sailors and the captain, escapes from the ship and goes to the island by boat, which will be the second part of the game.

Hope you enjoy

short_description: An exciting and engaging game in the horror and jump scare genre in the action/adventure/stealth style. The game mechanics are similar to those of Inside and Fahrenheit, designed to give the player a sense of action and greater visual appeal.
